notes.b1/j1/B-r1: Careful opacity/transform-only glow with staggered curves and good focus/reduced-motion, but the demo button is a small secondary one and the effect is a modest blue smudge.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Lovely full-width gradient button with slow lilac wash and drifting arrow, but 'transition: all', 1s+ timings and a whitened label at peak hurt legibility and snappiness.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: Glass pill on a dark glow field with a fast clear hover-in, lingering soft glow on exit, strong focus and reduced-motion handling, cheap pre-blurred layers.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Most ethereal: blooming blurred halo with overshoot bezier, appearing arrow and slow exhale release, though infinite float/spin loops and blur filter transitions cost more to render.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Glass pill with a pre-blurred glow that arrives fast and lingers on release via custom curves; very safe, legible, and cheap (opacity/transform only), but the effect is modest and the CTA is a ghost button.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Gradient hero pill with blurred bloom, orbiting halo, overshoot and slow exhale curves feels the most ethereal, with reduced-motion and focus handled, though long filter transitions and infinite loops cost a bit.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Full-width light-theme CTA with drifting gradient wash, arrow slide and long soft settle looks lovely, but the white label loses contrast mid-hover as the surface washes pale.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: Careful layered timing with delayed glow tail and good focus/reduced-motion, but the showcased hover is a small secondary button with a faint blue smudge that reads more tidy than dreamlike.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Three distinct beziers with long 1-2s blurred aura, drifting halo and arrow reveal on a dark cohesive page, with focus ring and reduced-motion handled; slightly heavy with animated blur layers.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Glassy button with lingering pre-blurred glow (opacity/transform only) and good focus and reduced-motion, but the fast 190ms face response makes the effect read as a glow-up more than ethereal.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: Technically careful (pre-blurred glow, settle bezier, fine-pointer gating) but the subtle blue glow on a flat lavender page is modest and the secondary buttons look cluttered.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Pastel gradient wash with overshoot and spinning aura feels airy and the full-width button is clear on phone, but the label washes out mid-hover and transition:all plus a light page are less disciplined.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Frosted glass pill with a drifting light and nice halo, but the small label and low-contrast resting button feel weak, and the effect stays fairly subtle.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Gradient shift with a drifting light blob, overshoot bezier and arrow nudge reads clearly dreamy, with strong label contrast and a polished card, though 1s transitions run long.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Careful bezier set, clean focus ring and reduced-motion handling, but the glow is subtle and the stacked buttons including Sold out clutter the demo.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Pastel iridescent pill with a blurred bloom and gentle arrow drift feels airy and legible, with good focus outline and reduced-motion override.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: Disciplined cyan halo and light sweep on a solid indigo button with strong focus ring, active state and reduced-motion handling, but the effect is subtle rather than truly ethereal.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Pastel iridescent pill with a blurred spinning bloom, long exhale easings and drifting arrow feels genuinely dreamlike, though the pale rest state has a soft affordance and the bloom is the heaviest to render.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Saturated gradient button with an overshoot lift, light-band sweep and halo reads clearly at rest and gets ethereal on hover, with good focus and reduced-motion support.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Glass button with a halo and sheen looks nice in motion but the translucent rest state with a small label has weak contrast and affordance on the dark blurred backdrop.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Pastel pearl pill with blurred rotating aurora and slow exhale curves feels truly ethereal with good reduced-motion and focus handling, though the pale button has soft rest affordance.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: Polished, accessible dark card with tidy glow and sheen and strong focus ring, but the hover is restrained and reads more refined than dreamy.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Glassy button gets a pleasant luminous bloom on hover, but the small label and dull rest state weaken affordance and hierarchy.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Clear gradient CTA with a slow drifting light bloom and long soft settle that feels dreamy yet obvious, with focus and reduced motion covered.
